Centre plans ₹5,000 crore scheme for green steel technology

The Indian government is planning a new scheme with an outlay of ₹5,000 crore to promote green steel technologies. This initiative aims to reduce emissions within the steel sector. The scheme is expected to be launched within the next three months.
